note: Fixture values, not measurements of this repository. The metric names are TARGET T9's scorecard rows (T-t9-01 fixes the loop rule this harness runs: work the metric furthest from its target and stop when every target holds); the numbers are chosen so one loop exercises a failed gate, an inconclusive gate and four passing ones. Nothing here reads STATUS.md, kb/ledger.jsonl or the validator.

metrics.row: T9.4 measured done: at least half of all definitions of done have a measured run
T9.2 sourced share: proposed rows are under 30 percent of all rows
T9.8 freshness: zero status rows stale against the ledger at every checkpoint

candidates.rationale: record the two runs that were performed but never written down
re-author the same change against the pinned unit the baseline was taken at
close the last definition of done that has a criterion and no run
sweep the stale rows, gated over a selector that matches no case
sweep the stale rows again with the whole case set selected
cite the rows that carry a source and are still marked proposed
